title: Before Wudhu
translation: Commence Wudhu in the name of Allah, and all praise be to Allah.
virtue: For keeping me faithful in the religion of Islam.

title: Whilst Making Wudhu
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي وَوَسِّعْ لِي فِي دَارِي وَبَارِكْ لِي فِي رِزْقِي
translation: O Allah, forgive my sins, grant me abundance in my home, and bless me in my livelihood.

title: After Wudhu
arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ، وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
translation: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, He has no partner. And I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger. O Allah, make me among those who constantly repent, and make me among those who purify themselves.
virtue: The eight doors of Jannah will be opened for the one who recites this dua, and he will have the choice to enter from whichever door he wishes.

title: When Entering the Masjid
translation: O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy.

title: When Leaving the Masjid
translation: O Allah, verily I seek from You Your bounty.

title: After Drinking Water
arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي سَقَانَا عَذْبًا فُرَاتًا بِرَحْمَتِهِ وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْهُ مِلْحًا أُجَاجًا بِذُنُوبِنَا
translation: All praise is due to Allah who gave us fresh, sweet water to drink out of His mercy, and did not make it salty and bitter due to our sins.

title: After drinking milk
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيْهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ
translation: O Allah, grant us blessings and abundance in it (the milk).

title: When wearing clothes
arabic: الْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِّنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةَ
translation: All praise is due to Allah who has clothed me with these garments and given them to me without any effort or help from my side.

title: When looking into the mirror
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنتَ حَسَّنْتَ خَلْقِي فَحَسَنْ خُلُقِي
translation: O Allah, You have beautified my body, so beautify my character.

title: When entering the home
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْمَوْلَجِ وَخَيْرَ الْمَخْرَجِ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
translation: O Allah, I ask You for the blessings of entering the home and leaving it. In the name of Allah we enter and in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we rely.

title: When leaving home
arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah. There is no power to do good or abstain from evil except with the help of Allah.
virtue: 1. You will be guided and protected. 2. The angels say: You shall be guided, your needs fulfilled, you will be protected, and shaytan will stay away from you.

title: When bidding someone farewell
arabic: اسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ دِينَكَ وَأَمَانَتَكَ وَخَوَاتِيمَ عَمَلِكَ
translation: I entrust to Allah your religion, your belongings, and the final outcome of your deeds.

title: When it rains
translation: O Allah, send upon us beneficial rain.

title: On hearing good news
translation: All praise be to Allah. Just as Allah willed.

title: When a loss occurs
translation: Surely we belong to Allah and to Him is our return.

title: When in bodily pain
arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ (3 times), أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ (7 times)
translation: I seek protection in Allah and His might against the evil of what I feel and fear.

title: When in difficulty
arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيْلُ وَعَلَى اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا
translation: Allah is sufficient for us and He is the Best Helper. And upon Allah we rely.
